pro_course_detail.description:
I prepare you for your International English exam like IELTS or TOEFL, FCE, CPE, PET, etc. My students generally have a 100% pass rate, provided that they do their homework, practice daily, and give themselves enough time to prepare.

I have helped quite a few students reach their required band score! One student increased his speaking band score by 2 levels! They are now able to study and work abroad. Another teenage student went from A1 - C1 in about 3 years!

You don't need to know the dictionary to reach your required band score! The speaking test requires everyday English, no need for fancy or complex words or phrases. Getting a band score of 7 or above could change your life forever! For this, you will need to use the English language creatively, using complex grammatical structures and various vocabulary. 
Having helped many IELTS students, I understand the pressure and struggles that IELTS students go through to reach their required band scores. These are predominantly students who are struggling to achieve a band 7 score either because of the speaking or writing part. The IELTS exam is life-changing in many ways and I would love to help you achieve your dreams. These customized lessons will help you reach your required band score.  

I will identify the areas where you are struggling and create an effective plan to correct those mistakes. I will be offering you some tips and strategies to make sure that you are ready to ace your exam! You will feel empowered to face the exam head-on. The student will also be able to pay more attention to their areas of weakness while improving their areas of strength. 

Your progress will be measurable. As part of your continual learning, I also send short videos or audio on request, that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

course_info.trial_description:
A trial lesson entails getting to know my student so that I can assess her English level and needs.  Students can expect to learn about conversational English where we will focus on Pronunciation, articulation and grammar. My lessons are student-oriented, fun and interactive. The main focus of the lesson is to enable the student to have basic English communication skills through a lot of speaking. 

I incorporate various methods such as Communicative language teaching, Task-based language teaching, Audio-lingual as well as the Total physical response to help my students to effectively acquire language skills, particularly in areas like listening, speaking, reading and writing.

I personalise lessons according to the students needs and goals and allow them to practice the English language in a way that stimulates the real-world communication, ultimately leading to better fluency and understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English for beginners.
